title: Sketch provided by Witness 4: blue-ink drawing of lights over ridgelines and a glowing orb
description: Blue-ink sketch on lined notebook paper, captioned "Sketch provided by Witness 4". It shows a large curved arc across the upper part of the page with dots and dashes along and above it, wavy squiggles, several horizontal ridgeline curves, and a densely scribbled circular orb with radiating strokes at lower left. The text above quotes the witness on an object "static and hovering in between two mountain ridges" and a later yellow light below a hillside ridgeline that moved "North to South." Marked UNCLASSIFIED, page 3, with the signature block of the Director, AARO.
